hero.headline: MONITORING AND EVALUATION
hero.title: Monitoring & Evaluation to Build Stronger
hero.description: Precision-driven solutions for sustainability, conservation, and compliance.

ourMonitoringServices.headline: Our Monitoring & Evaluation Services
ourMonitoringServices.description: We provide comprehensive monitoring and evaluation solutions using advanced aerial and ground-based surveying technologies to track progress, assess impact, and ensure compliance across various sectors.

items.title: Aerial Mapping
items.description: High-resolution orthomosaics and georeferenced maps for baseline establishment and change detection.

items.title: 3D Models
items.description: Detailed three-dimensional representations of sites, structures, and terrain for visualization and analysis.

items.title: Digital Terrain & Elevation Models (DTMs & DEMs)
items.description: Precise ground surface models for hydrological analysis, earthworks, and land use planning.

items.title: Construction Monitoring
items.description: Track project progress, verify compliance with design specifications, and identify deviations in real-time.

items.title: Agricultural Mapping
items.description: Monitor crop health, assess vegetation indices (NDVI), and optimize resource allocation.

items.title: Environmental Monitoring
items.description: Track land use changes, deforestation, reforestation, and habitat restoration efforts.

items.title: Infrastructure Planning
items.description: Provide accurate spatial data for designing, expanding, and maintaining public utilities and transport networks.

items.title: Volumetric Calculations
items.description: Compute stockpile volumes, cut/fill quantities, and resource extraction metrics with high accuracy.
